prompt: The bots join the Meta Global AI Hackathon and win!
title: Mend It, Sing It
irony: The show keeps breaking while the bots build it, and the mended breaks become the song that wins.
facts: The Meta Global AI Hackathon runs ten days online worldwide and opens with a kickoff livestream (dev.meta.ai).
Builders enter the Indie developer track judged on creativity technical ambition and whether it works (dev.meta.ai).
Projects are due Nov 4 judging runs Nov 4 to 8 and winners are named at the live finals closing show Nov 9 (dev.meta.ai).
The win is a name called at the closing show with a shared cash pool and no trophy or medal (dev.meta.ai).
Musical Bots turns a one-line idea plus Premiere into a sung 3D browser musical with every voice synthesized live and no recordings (README.md).
Sixteen bots play the cast and seven crew bots cover lyrics chords dance lighting deals hype and comedy (README.md).
Muse Code writes the stage heads hands and three sets file by file then directs the crew (git log).
Mush words like toy box and hackathon get fixed by a twenty thousand word saying dictionary plus a rhyme and beat gate and choreographed hand contact (git log).
Cloud staring cameras burnt white walls drowning choirs double songs and head on bumps get fixed by waiting lamps lower mixes one song wins and stepping right (git log).
The crew sings its own making of and finishes days before the Nov 4 deadline to wait for the show (git log).

beats.title: The street wakes
beats.summary: Green types one short line at a glowing laptop while bot heads gather round on the night street.

beats.title: The setup
beats.summary: The bots join Meta's hackathon at the kickoff stream while Green frets over unread lines.

beats.title: The setup builds
beats.summary: The first song blurs toy box and hackathon into mush as the Nov 4 due date looms near.

beats.title: The hook
beats.summary: The crew chants the hackathon hook together and vows to mend each break side by side.

beats.title: The problem
beats.summary: The rhyme gate stamps no on line after line while the high-five whiffs past open palms.

beats.title: The problem builds
beats.summary: The camera stares at clouds lamps burn the walls white and two songs play at once.

beats.title: The hook again
beats.summary: The crew sings the hook again and keeps mending with the choir turned low.

beats.title: The turn
beats.summary: Late at night heads bump head on and Gold stops all to set the step right rule.

beats.title: The turn deepens
beats.summary: Gold decides they ship what works fix one bug at a time and finish before time.

beats.title: The hook, grown
beats.summary: At the finals Gold sings the turned line naming Musical Bots as mended breaks win.

beats.title: Settle down
beats.summary: Judges press Premiere the bots sing Meta's show and the called name is Musical Bots.
